item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 09/Oct/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A cooler replenishment of the northeast monsoon will reach the coastal areas of southern China tonight. The weather is expected to be generally fine and dry over the region this week. It will be cooler in the morning and at night. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large.

Date/Month: 09/10 (Sunday)
Wind: East force 4 to 5, becoming north at night, occasionally force 6 offshore.
Weather: Sunny periods. One or two showers in the morning and at night.
Temp range: 25 - 32 C
R.H. range: 60 - 85 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 10/10 (Monday)
Wind: North force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground.
Weather: One or two light rain patches at first. Becoming fine and dry during the day.
Temp range: 23 - 29 C
R.H. range: 40 - 85 per Cent
PSR: Low
